Hello Luigi,

out

Vaishnavi

Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R9 170002645, MP / R9 170002554
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
pCX668, jQVpnB
Problem Description
: Chargers not working
Troubleshooting
: Please note, we checked and found that chargers are offline on our backend (SCB). Hence we are unable to reboot the charger remotely. However, it appears to be online on the OCPP backend.
Could you please perform a hard reset from the OCPP backend to see if the chargers comes back online on SCB? Once done, kindly inform us.
If the charger still remains offline, we will notify our field service team to check further.
For future reference, your case number is 0400033, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vaishnavi Raut
